description: Defines the TensorWrapper class used in functorch for autograd and gradient transforms, including methods for creating, copying, and managing tensor metadata.

classes.name: TensorWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper subclass of TensorImpl for functorch's autograd-based gradient transforms, capable of holding its own autograd metadata and participating in separate autograd graphs.

methods.name: level
methods.description: Returns the level of the tensor if it is alive.

methods.name: is_immutable
methods.description: Checks if the tensor is immutable.

methods.name: is_alive
methods.description: Checks if the tensor wrapper is still alive.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor and detaches it from the autograd graph.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies metadata from another tensor implementation.

methods.name: tensorimpl_type_name
methods.description: Returns the type name of the tensor implementation.
